title: China unveils world’s top open-source AI and a 2T parameter #kimiK3nc #AlibabaQuen #AIbreakthroughs
description: China released the world's most advanced open source AI model alongside a new tool enabling a 2 trillion parameter model to run on a laptop with just 8 GB of RAM and no GPU. This breakthrough dramatically lowers hardware requirements for large-scale AI, making ultra-powerful models accessible to a broader range of users. Recent AI advancements include Qtie’s PocketTTS, a fast voice cloning model, Hermes Skills Hub with 90,000 free community AI skills, and Meta’s MuseCode coding agent that enhances developer workflows. Alibaba’s Quen 3.8 Max leads Chinese AI models with 2.4 trillion parameters and extensive multimedia understanding, demonstrating significant strides in both performance and versatility. These innovations highlight a rapid shift in AI democratization, bridging the gap between top-tier models and everyday computing power. The accessibility of open source and lightweight AI solutions fosters accelerated innovation and adoption across industries. #ChinaAI #OpenSourceAI #PocketTTS #HermesSkillsHub #MetaMuseCode #AlibabaQuen #AIInnovation #TrillionParameterModel #VoiceCloning #AIModelRun #LargeLanguageModel #GrokImagine #AIResearch #AIAccessibility #AIApplications
